# Acceptance gate for epic opi-q5k

Close this ticket ONLY when:

1. The check-completion gate is closed (confirms every per-file check ticket was processed).
2. Every compliance ticket created under epic opi-q5k is closed.
3. A final sanity sweep confirms no upstream test file in tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/*.test.ts introduces a behavior uncovered in apps/octo_pi_tui/test/.

# How to verify

- \`bw list --parent opi-q5k --all\` — every child (except this ticket) must be closed.
- \`bw blocked\` — this ticket should report no remaining blockers.
- Grep sanity check: for a sampling of 3-5 upstream \`test(...)\` titles, confirm a matching Elixir test exists.

# On completion

Post a comment summarizing:
- Total upstream tests enumerated
- Total Elixir tests now covering them
- Any upstream tests deliberately skipped (with justification — e.g., Node-specific APIs with no Elixir analogue)
title: Acceptance gate: 100% upstream TUI test parity achieved
